root_cause_as_read_from_the_sources.conclusion: the gap is in the fixture-owned shutdown, not in a lost production owner: the attempt02 raw results show the read worker STARTED and alive in every iteration of the drain, the product naming reader_finished=false, read_end_closed=false and worker_thread_handle_released=false, and the thread still alive after the batch

the_fix: the returned state of the product and its stop facts are still sealed BEFORE the fixture cleanup; the shutdown never relabels them and never renews a deadline of the product

the workers of the two endpoints of the ACTUAL zero channel are asked to stop and to cancel their in-flight operation, bounded, with the production methods of the worker itself (stop_accepting and request_cancel); every failure is retained with its exact type and its exact detail and the original exception keeps the priority

the REPEATABLE production close of the channel is repeated by the drain, so the production closes the read end itself and releases the handle of the thread of its worker; the production closes the read end only after the reader of the channel really ended, so the read end is never closed under a live reader and no handle is bypassed

the **repeatable** production close of the channel is repeated AFTER the drain, bounded and with its errors retained: the close that the drain carried may still have found a worker that was alive and kept the handle of its thread, so the release of the handles is asked of the production again once the drain really joined the workers

the release of the handles is a HARD verdict and not a displayed fact: the thread of every worker that the round really registered must really have ended, its handle must really have been released and no endpoint of the round may still retain a worker; the state is read and never inferred, and a worker that is still alive, a handle that was not released, a retained worker, an unknown owner or a missing result all fail the round with it
the join of the owners is the join the fixture already had: the overall bound of 30 seconds and the bound of 10 seconds per owner are unchanged; no new budget, deadline or context was introduced

the compact actual facts of the shutdown are recorded: the result of every stop and cancel, the real liveness, the real join state and the real handle state of the workers afterwards, and the facts of the last production close; the state is read and never inferred
an owner that is still alive, an unknown owner or a missing result still fails the round: the hard cleanup verdict is kept and no error is suppressed
